verdict.rationale: Missive ships rules that run on their own: plans include 'Rules & automations' with up to 1000 rules. Multi-step rules wait, check conditions and act over calendar time or business hours (e.g., label at 24h, notify at 48h, reassign at 72h). Rules can create drafts, 'AI rules' are mentioned, and long assistant sessions no longer need babysitting. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of AI-powered rules (triggers, actions, what the LLM can do unattended), a documented catalog of rule triggers and actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration that background automations run reliably.
